Dataset 1: Manga Text & Speech Bubble Detection Dataset (Bulut va Matn Chegaralarini Aniqlash)
Ushbu ma'lumotlar to'plami manga, manhva va manhua sahifalaridagi nutq bulutlari (speech bubbles), fikr bulutlari (thought bubbles), qahramon matnlari va tovush effektlari (SFX) koordinatalarini aniqlash modelini (YOLOv8, RT-DETR, Comic-Text-Detector) o'qitish uchun mo'ljallangan.
1. Asosiy Ochiq Manbalar (Open-Source Data Sources)
Modelni o'qitishda quyidagi ochiq manbalardan foydalaniladi:
Manga109-s Dataset (Hugging Face): Tokio universiteti tomonidan yaratilgan 109 ta manga kitobi, 20,000 dan ortiq sahifa va yuz minglab speech balloon hamda matn bounding box annotatsiyalari.
Comic-Text-Detector Repository (GitHub): Manga va komikslardagi matn va qatorlarni segmentatsiya qilish uchun 13,000+ rasm asosida tayyorlangan dataset va arxitektura.
Manga109 API (GitHub): Manga109 XML annotatsiyalarini o'qish va koordinatalarni chiqarish kutubxonasi.
2. Standart Format: YOLO / COCO / JSONL
Har bir sahifadagi bulutlar va matn zonalari [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] hamda ko'pburchak (polygon) formatida saqlanadi.
JSONL Formatidagi Haqiqiy Namuna Yozuvlar (Training Data)

## 3. YOLOv8 Formatiga O'tkazish Python Skripti
Ushbu skript JSONL annotatsiyalarini YOLOv8 deteksiya modelini o'qitish formatiga (`labels/*.txt`) aylantirib beradi:
```python
import json
import os
def jsonl_to_yolo(jsonl_path: str, output_dir: str):
os.makedirs(os.path.join(output_dir, "labels"), exist_ok=True)
classes = {"speech_bubble": 0, "thought_bubble": 1, "sfx": 2, "narration_box": 3}
with open(jsonl_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
for line in f:
data = json.loads(line.strip())
w, h = data["width"], data["height"]
label_file = os.path.join(output_dir, "labels", f"{data['page_id']}.txt")
with open(label_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
for ann in data["annotations"]:
cls_id = classes.get(ann["category"], 0)
ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax = ann["bbox"]
# YOLO formati: class x_center y_center width height (0 dan 1 gacha normalizatsiya qilingan)
box_w = (xmax - xmin) / w
box_h = (ymax - ymin) / h
x_center = (xmin + xmax) / (2.0 * w)
y_center = (ymin + ymax) / (2.0 * h)
out.write(f"{cls_id} {x_center:.6f} {y_center:.6f} {box_w:.6f} {box_h:.6f}\n")
print(f"YOLO formatidagi annotatsiyalar {output_dir}/labels papkasiga saqlandi.")
